credibility.summary: Management demonstrates high credibility by consistently delivering EBITDA margins within their 22-24% guided range while successfully accelerating revenue growth from 0% to 14% YoY.
narrative_vs_numbers: Margin narrative aligns perfectly with reported OPM, which has stayed between 22% and 24% for nine consecutive quarters.
Revenue growth narrative of 'better FY27' is supported by the jump from 5% USG in FY26 to 12% USG in H1 FY27.
Volume growth narrative matches the data, showing an increase from 2% in Q2 FY26 to 7% in Q2 FY27.
